summary: Iteration 7 tested end to end (backend and UI): PA clients (6-character codice univoco, split payment), CIG/CUP/order-contract-agreement reference on invoices with FPA12 XML, split-payment totals and XML, correction and resend of SDI-rejected invoices with the same number, the registro numerazione API and page, quantity field width, and regression checks for numbering and storno totale. Backend: 18 of 18 new tests pass, and 22 of 22 iteration 6 tests pass after updating them to the new rules. UI: every requested flow works. One minor mobile layout bug in LineRow.

ui_bugs.issue: The new min-w-[5.5rem] on line-quantita-0 makes the col-span-3 cell wider than its grid column on mobile. The quantity input overlaps the price input, and the IVA select overlaps the line total ('IVA 2' is covered by '1000,00 €'). Desktop is fine (112px, shows 1000).

issues: The summary-split label 'IVA split payment (versata dall'ente)' wraps, and the value '- 220.000,00 €' also wraps onto 2 lines (cramped). Add whitespace-nowrap on the value.
Data and rif_data use the browser's native date input (mm/dd/yyyy shown in an en-US browser) instead of a shadcn calendar. This was already the case before this iteration.

action_items: LineRow mobile: fix the overlap of quantity/price and IVA/total. For example use col-span-4 for quantity on mobile and give price/IVA/total their own row, or drop min-w below md (md:min-w-[5.5rem]).
Optional: whitespace-nowrap on the summary-split value in the editor Riepilogo.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1158 lines (above 700). Split it into routers (auth, parties, invoices, sdi, registro).
registro: free numbers below the first number (e.g. primo=3, so 1-2 are free) are not listed as free. The UI explains this with registro-start-note, which is fine if intended.
build_xml creates DatiBeniServizi before DatiFattureCollegate is appended to DatiGenerali. The output is still correct because they are different parents, but the code order is confusing.
test_iteration5_credit_notes.py setup fails with 401 'Sessione non valida' (it depends on seed_sessions.js sessions that no longer exist). This is a problem in the test setup, not the app.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6_numbering_lock.py (updated to the max+1 rule and to scartata now being editable)
seed_data_creation: seed_ui_t7.py creates TEST_T7 admin/session/company (P.IVA 77777777772), the PA client, the B2B clients, the scartata invoice and a registro gap in the previous year. All of it was cleaned with --clean. The pytest module cleans its own data (P.IVA 77777777771).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend/tests && pytest test_iteration7_pa_scartate_registro.py test_iteration6_numbering_lock.py -n 0. The system date is 2026-10-29. The registro gap tests use the previous year (2025) so they don't collide with 2026 data. Iteration 6 tests now simulate a legacy gap through mongo, because manual numero > max+1 is rejected. UI seed: python seed_ui_t7.py (prints ids; cookie session_token=test_session_t7_ui, localStorage fe_company_id=CID), then --clean.
rca of the issue: Mobile LineRow overlap: grid col-span-3 of a 308px row is about 70px, but the input now has min-width 88px, so it overflows into the next columns.
